_doc: Emission factors per unit of final energy. Configurable; values are consistent with Swiss LCA methodology (Mobitool / KBOB).

electricity._doc: Per kWh of electricity consumed (Swiss consumer mix, lifecycle including upstream).

diesel_heating._doc: Per liter of diesel burned in an auxiliary heater (lifecycle including upstream). NOx and PM are lower than engine combustion because heaters use clean catalytic burners.

diesel_bus._doc: Per liter of diesel consumed by a full diesel bus engine (lifecycle including upstream). Higher NOx and PM than a heater due to engine combustion characteristics.

diesel_comparator_lca_vehicles._doc: Canonical diesel comparator LCA vehicles per ELETTRA size class. Used for lifecycle phase-share allocation in the yearly-analysis emissions endpoint.
